objections.label: S16-BASELINE
objections.statement: Identical arm laws are said to imply open residual zero.
objections.finding: The mechanism defines an absolute residual R_U=mu(U)(E_mu[z|U]-m_U) against a frozen reference. Identical arms guarantee M_A-M_B=0 and R_U,A-R_U,B=0; they do not force R_U,A=R_U,B=0 for an arbitrary m_U. No condition elsewhere in this body identifies m_U with their common conditional mean. The mechanism itself explicitly admits a nonzero R_U.
objections.counterexample_or_mutation: Keep both arm laws and multiplicities identical, mu(U)>0, and choose a frozen reference m_U different from their common conditional mean. The two residuals coincide but are nonzero. This is a direct reading of the declared formula, not an executed fixture.
objections.smallest_complete_fix: In a complete additive successor, replace absolute open residual zero by zero residual difference between the identical arms; alternatively explicitly set m_U to their common open conditional mean in the baseline slice. Keep arbitrary frozen references and nonzero residuals permitted in the general mechanism.
objections.scope_limit: One baseline identity only. RT7 no longer makes the overbroad monodromy necessity claim and is cleared at specification scope.

objections.label: S11-COST
objections.statement: Dense certification of the newly defined truncated saturated torsion profile is priced solely with binomial(n+D,D), where D is the output-degree window.
objections.finding: The new invariant uses I:d^infinity. Bounding the degrees j of the reported torsion classes does not bound the powers of d or degrees of ideal-membership witnesses needed to certify those classes and saturation completeness. The body supplies neither a saturation-exponent/witness-degree bound nor an independently certified saturated input. The generic runtime obligation and statement that both costs are retained do not provide the missing parameter. This is a cost-specification omission; it is not a claim that no such bound or efficient certificate can exist.
objections.counterexample_or_mutation: Hold the reported class degree j and output cutoff D fixed while allowing a homogeneous generator x^e y, denominator x, and increasing e. Certification of the low-degree class represented by y can require a d-power witness of degree exceeding the output window. The suggested paper audit must account for that witness before pricing the profile; no ideal computation was executed here.
objections.smallest_complete_fix: In a complete additive successor, separate output cutoff D from a certified saturation/witness degree E or exponent bound. Price saturation construction and completeness verification explicitly, and use the E-sized matrix only under its stated sufficiency hypothesis. A narrower alternative is to accept an independently certified truncated saturated module as supplied input and limit the D-sized bound to operations on that input, leaving its production/completeness cost explicit and unresolved.
objections.scope_limit: RT6 is cleared: the invariant is now well-defined as a truncated graded profile, and no finite last degree follows from finite generation. V1 for this card is also cleared by d=1. The remaining objection concerns the general cost field only.
